title: Tiered release gate then atomic ship

steps.action: Classify the change set and declare the gate tier (narrow/windowed/ship) with the reason on record; when in doubt choose the higher tier
Run the gate to green including the security audit; a red gate stops the release and enters failure analysis, never a retry loop
Bump the version as its own commit, build locked, install atomically, then verify the installed binary reports the new version
Publish the channel pointer and verify the public pointer resolves to the new version before announcing

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task prepares or executes a product release
